response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong backgrounds in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, but his profile does not align with this role's core requirement of deep, current C++ development for industrial automation. His only substantial C++ exposure was over a decade ago (2012-2015) with minor mentions, and there is no evidence of MQTT, IEC 62443, industrial protocols, UML/architecture documentation for embedded systems, or SDL practices.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple domains
Demonstrated experience with distributed systems, microservices, and high-performance/low-latency systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers)
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (last significant use ~2014-2015), not matching the 8-12 years of C++-focused experience required
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, industrial cybersecurity, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.)
No mention of MQTT, message brokers, or IoT-specific REST/MQTT interface development

key_factors.factor: Lack of current, deep C++ expertise
